title: Q-EXP-a5633f27: close the other-cloud gap with a measured change
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every rnd pass
**Done check:** file:docs/bootstrapping/other-cloud-proof.json
**Prediction:** pageviews_7d >= baseline within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Experiment from R&D finding `gap:other-cloud`.
Hypothesis: 3 competitors evidence 'runs on more than one cloud'; building it should move the metric
Metric: pageviews_7d. Ship the smallest change the done check proves, then compare the metric against its baseline in doctrine/growth.json; a miss reverts the change and lowers the finding's priority.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 97.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
